texts.text_span: Filed August 28, 2025 Before:  Susan P. Graber, Consuelo M. Callahan, and Lucy H. Koh, Circuit Judges. ORDER Judge  Graber  and  Judge  Callahan  voted  to  deny  the petition for panel rehearing.  Judge Koh voted to grant the petition for panel rehearing.  Judge Callahan voted to deny the  petition  for  rehearing  en  banc,  and  Judge  Graber  so recommended.  Judge Koh voted to grant the petition for rehearing en banc. The full court was advised of the petition for rehearing en banc.  A judge of the court requested a vote on whether to rehear the matter en banc.  The matter failed to receive a majority of votes of the nonrecused active judges in favor of en banc consideration.  Fed. R. App. P. 40.  Judge Owens did not participate in the deliberations or vote in this case. The petition for panel rehearing and rehearing en banc, Dkt. No. 76, is DENIED.
